feature-builder.description: Builds complete features (backend + frontend + tests) for the clinic management app. When you say a feature name like 'Patients', 'Schedule', 'Inventory', 'Pharmacy', 'Lab', 'EHR', 'Billing', 'Doctor Management', 'Emergency', 'Telemedicine', or 'Settings', this agent reads the feature specs from feature-list.md and feature-progress.md, then implements everything.
